cards.title: generator-driven turn state machine
cards.trigger: query() receives an initial message set and ToolUseContext
cards.transition: stream model events; record tool_use blocks; execute or drain tools; synthesize missing results on abort/error; either return a terminal reason or replace State and continue
invariants: tool_use blocks must receive tool_result closure
turn and recovery budgets are bounded
fallback attempts discard results from the failed attempt
failureAndRecovery: model/runtime errors become explicit terminal results
abort drains or synthesizes tool results
prompt and output limits use bounded recovery transitions
maxTurns returns max_turns

cards.title: tool proposal to authorized effect interpreter
cards.trigger: a streamed ToolUseBlock is handed to runToolUse
cards.transition: resolve tool and validate input; run hook and permission layers; deny with structured tool_result or execute; normalize progress, success, and error results
invariants: unknown and invalid tools do not execute
non-allow permission outcomes do not cross the effect boundary
every path attempts a protocol-compatible tool_result
failureAndRecovery: hook and permission denials return reasons
AbortError is distinguished from tool failure
post-failure hooks may add bounded retry guidance without executing a retry themselves

cards.title: provider stream reducer and late finalization
cards.trigger: queryModelWithStreaming opens an API event stream
cards.transition: content_block_start allocates state; delta events append typed fragments; content_block_stop yields an assistant slice; message_delta mutates final usage and stop reason on the already-yielded object
invariants: delta type must match the target content-block type
content-block indexes must exist
late usage and stop data must reach the queued transcript reference
failureAndRecovery: malformed event order throws explicit errors
idle stream abort falls back to non-streaming logic
user abort is not reported as model failure

cards.title: queued append-only JSONL journal
cards.trigger: messages, queue operations, metadata, or recovery records are admitted for persistence
cards.transition: insertMessageChain assigns parent links; appendEntry filters or routes entry kinds; enqueueWrite batches serialized lines; flush appends per-file content in order
invariants: main-chain UUID dedup differs from sidechain local persistence
entry order is retained per file
progress messages do not participate in the parent chain
failureAndRecovery: flush can be awaited at shutdown
missing directories are created on append
remote persistence is separated from local sidechain dedup semantics

cards.title: transcript graph reconstruction and repair
cards.trigger: a persisted JSONL transcript is loaded for resume, branch, share, or agent recovery
cards.transition: parse records; bridge legacy gaps; relink preserved compact segments; delete and bridge snipped ranges; walk leaf-to-root with cycle detection; recover orphaned parallel siblings/tool results
invariants: cycle yields a bounded partial chain
deleted middle ranges cannot leave dangling survivor parents
parallel tool-use siblings remain API-pairable after reconstruction
failureAndRecovery: malformed preserved metadata falls back to fuller history
resume consistency emits an expected-versus-actual delta
legacy records are handled by read-side repair

cards.title: provider-message compiler and tool-pair repair
cards.trigger: internal transcript messages must become provider API MessageParam records
cards.transition: normalize and merge internal messages; remove unsupported fields; insert synthetic error results for orphan tool uses; remove orphan or duplicate results; add cache markers
invariants: tool_use/tool_result IDs are paired before API submission
provider-incompatible internal metadata is removed
cache annotations do not mutate reusable source blocks in place
failureAndRecovery: missing tool results become synthetic error results
orphan results are stripped
empty messages after repair receive bounded fallback handling
recommendedRepresentation: loss table from internal to provider model

cards.title: input-dependent tool scheduling and deterministic context fold
cards.trigger: one assistant turn yields one or more tool calls
cards.transition: partition consecutive safe calls into concurrent batches and unsafe calls into singleton serial batches; execute with a bounded concurrency cap; fold context modifiers in original block order
invariants: classification errors fail closed to serial execution
unsafe tools do not share a concurrent batch
context mutations are applied deterministically after a concurrent batch
failureAndRecovery: schema parse failure is non-concurrent
tool-level failure remains a result rather than aborting scheduling by default
in-progress IDs are removed at completion

cards.title: lossy context migration with bounded retries
cards.trigger: estimated token use crosses an auto/manual threshold or recovery requests compaction
cards.transition: decide eligibility; summarize older context; retry prompt-too-long by truncating oldest API-round groups; emit boundary and restoration attachments; reset or increment circuit-breaker state
invariants: compact and session-memory queries do not recursively autocompact
retries and consecutive failures are bounded
preserved context is explicitly represented after lossy summary
failureAndRecovery: three consecutive auto-compact failures open the circuit
prompt-too-long retries are limited to three
manual and automatic failure presentation differs

cards.title: optimistic file edit with atomic-replace attempt
cards.trigger: FileEditTool receives an old/new string edit after a prior file read
cards.transition: verify the expected string and match cardinality; synchronously re-read; reject stale state unless a full-read content check proves equality; compute patch; write a flushed temp file and rename; update read state
invariants: no await occurs between staleness check and write
file mode and symlink target behavior are preserved where possible
ambiguous multi-match edits require explicit replace_all
failureAndRecovery: stale content fails before write
atomic-replace failure falls back to a flushed direct write
temporary file cleanup is best effort

cards.title: headless conversation owner and SDK projection
cards.trigger: submitMessage or ask receives a headless SDK request
cards.transition: convert request to internal messages; persist durable checkpoints; drive query(); update the mutable conversation; normalize internal messages into SDK event/result shapes
invariants: conversation mutations and transcript checkpoints remain ordered
internal message variants are projected rather than leaked directly
abort and terminal reasons close the generator
failureAndRecovery: orphaned permission flows are repaired
compaction and tool results are recorded before later resume
headless caller receives terminal status rather than UI state

cards.title: input classification with remote-command safety gate
cards.trigger: raw string or content blocks enter processUserInputBase
cards.transition: normalize media; evaluate bridge-safe slash override; optionally route feature keyword; extract attachments; dispatch bash, slash command, or ordinary prompt
invariants: bridge clients cannot invoke unsafe local commands
unknown remote slash text falls through as plain text
image normalization precedes the ordinary prompt path
failureAndRecovery: unsafe remote command returns a local-command message without a model query
mode/input mismatch throws early
hook output is capped separately

cards.title: bounded WebSocket reconnection state machine
cards.trigger: session WebSocket closes or the caller forces reconnect
cards.transition: permanent close codes terminate; close 4001 receives a separately bounded increasing delay; other transient closes reconnect only from connected state; explicit close cancels timers; force reconnect resets budgets
invariants: permanent rejection never retries
timers are cleared on explicit close
send operations require connected state
failureAndRecovery: general retries stop after five
4001 retries stop after three
ping errors defer to the close handler
